description: Queue a free text task: draft, summarize, extract, translate text, reason or assist with code. No code is executed. Provide user/assistant messages, explicit consent for nonconfidential permitted content, and a stable idempotency key. Returns immediately with a job ID. Poll get_studio_job. Uses the configured local model, no external AI fallback.

access_token.description: Private token from create_trial_access; optional with Bearer authentication.

consent.description: Confirm permission to process this nonconfidential content.

messages.description: At most 12,000 characters in total. End with a user message. Include previous messages for follow-up context.

name: submit_chat_job
title: Generate text on the GPU
